name: Sheikhdom of Qatar
alt: Qatar under Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim

predecessors.name: Ottoman Empire
predecessors.text: Qatar, which 'the Ottomans had incorporated ... into their dominion' by January 1872 as a province in Najd, and over which they 'officially renounced sovereignty ... in 1913'

successors.name: Qatar (British protectorate)
successors.text: the Qatar peninsula, which 'became a British protectorate on 3 November 1916 when the United Kingdom signed a treaty with Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim Al Thani'

ledger.x: 1913: the Ottomans renounce sovereignty over Qatar and Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim Al Thani rules the peninsula.
1915: the last Ottoman garrison leaves Doha.
3 November 1916: Qatar becomes a British protectorate.
